# Northumbria University

> Northumbria University's study portal offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and research degrees with comprehensive support for admissions, funding, and student experience.

Northumbria University is a major UK institution based in Newcastle with multiple schools spanning computer science, engineering, business, healthcare, law, and creative industries. The site guides prospective and current students through course selection, application processes, financial support, and campus life.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Study
- Postgraduate Study
- PhD and Research Degrees
- UCAS Applications
- Scholarships and Funding
- Flexible Learning
- Student Support
- Campus Visits and Open Days
- Degree Apprenticeships
- Application Process
- Newcastle Campus
- School of Computer Science
- Newcastle Business School
- Student Accommodation
- International Students

## Undergraduate Study

- [Study an Undergraduate or Postgraduate Course in the UK](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria): Main hub for undergraduate, postgraduate, apprenticeships and CPD study options
- [Courses at University | Undergraduate Degrees](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/coming-to-northumbria): Undergraduate degree courses and degree program information
- [How to Apply for an Undergraduate Degree](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/guides): UCAS application guide with personal statement and interview tips
- [Foundation Year and Extended Degree](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/foundation-year-study): Foundation year and extended degree entry routes for students

## Postgraduate Study

- [Masters Degree | Postgraduate Courses](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/postgraduate-study): Postgraduate master's degrees and course search information
- [Masters Application Guide](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/postgraduate-study/application-guide): Postgraduate application process guide with entry requirements
- [Postgraduate Research Degrees | PhD and DBA Opportunities](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/postgraduate-research-degrees): PhD, DBA and postgraduate research degree opportunities with funding
- [Postgraduate Study Change Direction](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/postgraduate-study/change-direction): Career change postgraduate master's programs for different fields
- [Study Register Your Interest](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/postgraduate-study/pg-info-new/thinking-about-a-masters): Master's degree interest registration form for prospective students

## Admissions and Campus Visits

- [University Open Days in Newcastle](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/visit-northumbria/university-open-days): University open days and campus visit information for prospective students
- [Northumbria University UCAS Exhibitions](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/information-for-schools-and-colleges/visit-northumbria/ucas): UCAS exhibitions and recruitment events for prospective students
- [School & College Outreach](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/information-for-schools-and-colleges): School and college outreach programs including Evolve and support schemes
- [Parents Guide to University](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/coming-to-northumbria/parent-page): Comprehensive guide for parents on university admissions and student life

## Fees, Funding and Support

- [Tuition Fees, Funding and Scholarships](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/fees-funding): Tuition fees, scholarships, bursaries and financial support information
- [Unlock Your Potential with Learning Support](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/unlock-your-potential): Student support services including financial guidance and wellbeing

## Learning and Student Life

- [Experiential Learning Page](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/i-am-nu/experiential-learning): Real-world learning through internships, projects and work experience
- [Flexible Learning Courses & Training](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/our-courses/flexible-learning): Flexible, part-time and distance learning course options
- [Students' Union](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/study-at-northumbria/student-life/students-union): Students' Union information with societies, clubs and student support
- [The Student Hub](https://www.northumbria.ac.uk/thehub): Student experience hub showcasing life at Northumbria University
